title: Copulas & tail dependence
dek: Separating marginals from dependence for the S&P 500, FTSE 100 and Nikkei 225 — and measuring why the Gaussian copula misses joint crashes.
excerpt: Correlation is one number; dependence is a whole function. On 25 years of weekly S&P 500, FTSE 100 and Nikkei 225 returns we rank-transform to pseudo-observations, fit Gaussian and Student-t copulas by MLE, and show that empirical tail dependence rises exactly where the Gaussian copula sends it to zero — modelling the joint crashes that multi-asset stress scenarios exist for.

sections.title: The Gaussian copula — elegant, and wrong in the corner
